title: Ekabījīkathā
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Na vattabbaṁ— “ekabījī puggalo ekabījitāniyato”ti? Āmantā. Nanu so ekabījīti? Āmantā. Hañci so ekabījī, tena vata re vattabbe— “ekabījī puggalo ekabījitāniyato”ti. Ekabījīkathā niṭṭhitā.
